item.text: {"evidence_refs":["The old model's global least-squares fit has fit RMSE 0.2549 and dev RMSE 0.8752, so dependence on only u and h is inadequate.","At matched u=0.4 and h=0.3, dev means are about 1.313 for all-positive history and -0.721 for all-negative history, showing a large history effect.","At matched u=0.65 and h=0.5, observed_A means are about 0.644 for [1,0,0,0] and 0.941 for [0,0,0,1]; equal sums can yield different responses, so history placement matters.","The prior proposal was rejected because exp requires a dimensionless input; times/tau has time exponent zero and is dimensionless, but the proposed expression's dt factor gives the summed memory time units. The revised quantity omits dt because all supplied intervals have fixed dt=1 s."],"experiments":[{"h":0.5,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Measure oldest-pulse response at a new drive, paired with the newest-pulse condition to test temporal placement.","u":0.3},{"h":0.5,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Measure newest-pulse response at the same drive and wait; compare with the oldest-pulse condition.","u":0.3},{"h":1.5,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Repeat the oldest-pulse condition after a longer wait to test whether its contribution changes with waiting time.","u":0.3},{"h":1.5,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Repeat the newest-pulse condition after a longer wait, separating waiting-time effects from pulse-age effects." ,"u":0.3}],"exposed_inputs":["u","h","times"],"measurement_requests":["Collect four repeats per condition and report raw responses; retain the calibrated reference-channel error bound of 0.015 response units."],"parameters":[{"dimension":[1,0],"initial":1.0,"lower":0.1,"name":"tau","upper":8.0}],"quantities":[{"expression":"sum(history*exp(times/tau))","interpretation":"Dimensionless exponentially age-weighted summary of prior drive. Since each interval has dt=1 s, the fixed interval duration is omitted; times/tau is dimensionless. This is a candidate history representation, not a complete response law.","name":"memory"}],"rationale":"The matched-history contrasts establish that u and h alone omit relevant history information, while the isolated-pulse contrast shows that an unweighted sum cannot distinguish temporal placement. The all-positive history responses also vary with h, motivating a representation that discounts older input as time passes. The previous attempt failed dimensional validation because tau was declared dimensionless and the integral included dt, yielding a time-valued sum. This revision assigns tau time units and omits the fixed 1 s interval factor, leaving memory dimensionless and making exp(times/tau) valid. It is intentionally partial: no response coefficients or final response law are supplied. The four paired conditions vary pulse age and wait at a new controlled drive to test this representation."}
